title: pmd schedule --rows output, one row
description: One planning item of a scheduled file (informative). `pmd schedule FILE... [--deep] --rows` prints one such object per line (JSON Lines), in file order, files in load order; headings are not rows. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings or null. owner is the item's own owner:, else the nearest ancestor item's, else the file's Owner: text; owner_inherited is false when the owner came from the item itself or there is none.

file.description: The file the item is in, as loaded.

slack_days.description: Declared end minus forecast end, in days (negative in conflict).

estimate_days.description: The item's duration in days, or null without one.

parent_line.description: Line of the nearest enclosing planning item, or null.

leaf.description: True when no sub-item is open.
